parsed.title: Discussion on AI‑assisted job search and development tools

topics.title: AI tools for job searching and resume generation

claims.text: The author plans to set up an OpenClaw pipeline to find vacancies, generate PDFs of resumes and write cover letters.
Automation of resume generation is seen as beneficial because interviewers receive attached PDFs.
AI‑generated job‑search tooling is considered a market mainstream in 2026, and lacking such skills hampers job hunting for JS/Python developers.
The author expects recruiters as a profession to disappear eventually.

topics.title: Impact of AI on software development productivity

claims.text: AI can dramatically accelerate development by generating code (e.g., joining tables) and handling routine tasks.
The author warns that AI (referred to as “клод”) lowers the entry barrier to programming, leading to poorly optimized code and security issues.
Generated code may be unsafe or unreviewed, as illustrated by a teammate pushing SELECT * queries to production without approval.

topics.title: AI's role in recruitment and candidate search

claims.text: AI is increasingly used to search for candidates via keyword matching, but the author doubts its relevance to real hiring needs.
There is skepticism that AI can replace human analysis in recruitment.
The shift from older stacks to modern ones (REST, JSON, microservices, Docker) is likened to past transitions.
Development acceleration tools became widely effective only after 2025.
